objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation prefix for the document type used in the document name.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive 4-digit number assigned per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be rechecked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period (default 10 years) for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data or objects.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scopes or areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content or its translation.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client(s) in a multi-client system where the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document; it is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it along with its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (out-of-force) document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The system/license role assigned to the user (e.g. READER, AUTHOR).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution lists.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and/or individual persons assigned to a document to be notified upon release, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that routes tasks (creation sign-off, review, release, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, reactivation) to assigned participants.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location, etc.) to which documents or processes can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation or search report available in the system for analyzing documents.

attributes.name: report_name
attributes.description: The name of the report (e.g. Status report: Documents & Instruction).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable parameters and criteria that filter report results.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user- and role-specific view displaying relevant documents, tasks and evaluations.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type selected for the newly created document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is opened and modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creation_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution to readers in the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: A supplementary additional-info object is attached to a document without affecting its version.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional-info object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_new_document_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when revisions or triggering changes occur.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system generates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (and optionally author and reviewer) confirms the continued validity of a document, resetting the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, revoking all authorizations except the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, restoring its metadata, authorizations and attachments into a new version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons on a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or modified on the distribution list of a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is approved and released, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes or distribution events.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, an archived document is permanently deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is released together with a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary content attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity must be checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to declare it out of force.
A Request For Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
A Document can reference another Document via the References attribute.
A Document can be linked to a Process for process-specific filing.
A Document can be linked to an Organizational Unit.
A Document Template is associated with a document type and used when creating new Document objects.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to define recipients.
A Distribution List includes User Groups as recipients.
A Distribution List can include individual Users as recipients.
A User is assigned to one or more User Groups for authorization and role purposes.
Documents appear in role-specific Dashboards based on distribution group assignments.
